remarks: Welcome to 20 Daly Street, a charming second-floor condo tucked away on a quiet side street just off East Main in Stamford's sought-after East Side neighborhood. This well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. It is one of only a handful of units featuring a spacious primary bedroom with a large walk-in closet and in-unit laundry. A sun-filled living area opens to a private balcony, becoming the ideal spot for your morning coffee or evening unwind. The kitchen offers practical workspace and flows nicely into the dining and living area, perfect for entertaining. Want to restore the unit to its historic charm? Rip up the carpets and be greeted with the unit's original hardwood floors. Meanwhile, running out of space will never be an issue with every unit having a large 300+ cubic foot private storage in the basement and communal storage space on each floor near the elevator. With below-average HOA dues, assigned parking, and an unbeatable location just minutes from Downtown Stamford, shopping centers, restaurants, and public transportation - this home provides effortless living with a suburban feel. This is your chance to own a slice of Stamford in a peaceful community setting!
